title: Ignored artifacts convention in starter and guidelines
objective: Define the ignored artifacts/ convention in the neutral starter, contracts, templates and operations/quality guidance without weakening validators or schemas.
approved_sources: User authorization 2026-10-22: implement the ignored artifacts/ convention and publish one PR.

acceptance.description: The starter generates artifacts/* plus !artifacts/README.md and a tracked artifacts/README.md; a tool/run subdirectory is documented.
Contracts, templates and operations/quality guidance state the purpose, non-authority, ignored contents and no-secret/no-upload boundary.
evidence: verification.md: contract, template and operations/quality document inspection

acceptance.description: Existing validator exclusion, schemas, managed baseline and stricter gates are preserved; targeted tests pass.
evidence: verification.md: validate.py, trusted-base validator, maintenance checks and targeted tests; pre-existing Windows-only cases reproduce on pristine main

acceptance.description: Actual checks, frozen content subject, PR identity and remaining independent-review/human gates are recorded.
evidence: verification.md: local deterministic results and limits; independent review and PR readback pending

manual_evidence: Independent plan and Full review after deterministic checks

stop_conditions: Stop on scope or trust expansion beyond the recorded paths.
Stop if a required schema, validator, managed baseline or historical fixture must change.
Stop on unresolved confirmed findings or missing required evidence.
forbidden_actions: No merge, release, deployment, runner registration, protection or permission change.
No automatic downstream apply, credential exposure or artifact upload.
No weakening of validators, schemas, catalogs or historical records.
No force-push or destructive Git cleanup.
